name: @activepieces/piece-ko-fi
description: Receive triggers for donations, subscriptions, commissions, and shop orders from Ko-fi.

auth.description: Your Ko-fi webhook verification token. Find it in Ko-fi Dashboard > Settings > API/Webhooks > Advanced Settings > Webhook verification token.

new_donation.name: new_donation
new_donation.description: Triggers when a new one-time donation is received on Ko-fi.

instructions.description: To receive donation events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Donation" event type.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a supporter sends a one-time tip or donation to the connected Ko-fi creator account. Emits the donation event including the supporter name, email, message, amount, currency, and Ko-fi transaction ID. Use to thank supporters, log contributions, or trigger downstream notifications.

sampleData.message: Thanks for the work you do!

new_subscription.name: new_subscription
new_subscription.description: Triggers when a new subscription is received on Ko-fi.

instructions.description: To receive subscription events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Subscription" event type.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a supporter starts a new recurring membership on the connected Ko-fi creator account, only on the first subscription payment (recurring renewal payments do not trigger it). Emits the subscription event including the member name, email, message, amount, currency, and the membership tier name. Use to onboard new members, grant access, or send a welcome message.

sampleData.message: Thanks for the work you do!

new_commission.name: new_commission
new_commission.description: Triggers when a new commission is received on Ko-fi.

instructions.description: To receive commission events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Commission" event type.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a supporter places a paid commission request on the connected Ko-fi creator account. Emits the commission event including the requester name, email, the commission brief or message, amount, currency, and shipping details when delivery of a physical item is involved. Use to intake commission work, create tasks, or notify on new requests.

sampleData.message: Please draw my cat in the style of a renaissance portrait.

new_shop_order.name: new_shop_order
new_shop_order.description: Triggers when a new shop order is received on Ko-fi.

instructions.description: To receive shop order events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Shop Order" event type.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a supporter purchases an item from the Ko-fi shop on the connected creator account. Emits the order event including buyer name, email, amount, currency, the purchased shop items (with variation and quantity), and shipping details when the product requires delivery. Use to fulfill orders, record sales, or notify on new purchases.

fr.Receive triggers for donations, subscrip: Recevoir des déclencheurs pour les dons, abonnements, commissions et commandes de boutique de Ko-fi.
fr.Your Ko-fi webhook verification token. F: Votre jeton de vérification Ko-fi. Trouvez-le dans le tableau de bord Ko-fi > Réglages > API/Webhooks > Réglages Avancés > Jeton de vérification du Webhook.
fr.Triggers when a new one-time donation is: Déclenche quand un nouveau don unique est reçu sur Ko-fi.
fr.Triggers when a new subscription is rece: Déclenche quand un nouvel abonnement est reçu sur Ko-fi.
fr.Triggers when a new commission is receiv: Déclenche quand une nouvelle commission est reçue sur Ko-fi.
fr.Triggers when a new shop order is receiv: Déclenche quand une nouvelle commande est reçue sur Ko-fi.
fr.To receive donation events, set up a web: Pour recevoir des événements de dons, configurez un webhook dans votre tableau de bord Ko-fi : allez dans Paramètres > API/Webhooks, collez l'URL {{webhookUrl}}, et sélectionnez le type d'événement "Donation".
fr.To receive subscription events, set up a: Pour recevoir des événements d'abonnement, configurez un webhook dans votre tableau de bord Ko-fi : allez dans Paramètres > API/Webhooks, collez l'URL {{webhookUrl}}, et sélectionnez le type d'événement "Abonnement".
fr.To receive commission events, set up a w: Pour recevoir des événements de commission, configurez un webhook dans votre tableau de bord Ko-fi : allez dans Paramètres > API/Webhooks, collez l'URL {{webhookUrl}}, et sélectionnez le type d'événement "Commission".
fr.To receive shop order events, set up a w: Pour recevoir les commandes de la boutique, configurez un webhook dans votre tableau de bord Ko-fi : allez dans Paramètres > API/Webhooks, collez l'URL {{webhookUrl}}, et sélectionnez le type d'événement "Commande de boutique".

es.Triggers when a new one-time donation is: Se activa cuando se recibe una nueva donación única en Ko-fi.
es.Triggers when a new subscription is rece: Dispara cuando se recibe una nueva suscripción en Ko-fi.
es.Triggers when a new commission is receiv: Dispara cuando una nueva comisión es recibida en Ko-fi.
es.Triggers when a new shop order is receiv: Dispara cuando una nueva tienda es recibida en Ko-fi.
es.To receive donation events, set up a web: Para recibir eventos de donación, configure un webhook en su Tablero de Ko-fi: vaya a Ajustes > API/Webhooks, pega la URL {{webhookUrl}}y selecciona el tipo de evento "Donación".
es.To receive subscription events, set up a: Para recibir eventos de suscripción, configure un webhook en su panel de control de Ko-fi: vaya a Ajustes > API/Webhooks, pega la URL {{webhookUrl}}y selecciona el tipo de evento "Suscripción".
es.To receive commission events, set up a w: Para recibir eventos de comisiones, configure un webhook en su panel de Ko-fi: vaya a Ajustes > API/Webhooks, pega la URL {{webhookUrl}}y selecciona el tipo de evento "Comisión".
es.To receive shop order events, set up a w: Para recibir eventos de pedidos de la tienda, configure un webhook en su Tablero de Ko-fi: vaya a Ajustes > API/Webhooks, pega la URL {{webhookUrl}}y selecciona el tipo de evento "Shop Order".

ja.Receive triggers for donations, subscrip: Ko-Fiから寄付、サブスクリプション、手数料、ショップ注文に対するトリガーを受け取ります。
ja.Your Ko-fi webhook verification token. F: あなたのKo-fi Webhook検証トークン。Ko-Fiダッシュボード > 設定 > API/Webhooks > 詳細設定 > Webhook検証トークンから見つけてください。
ja.New Subscription: 新しいサブスクリプション
ja.Triggers when a new one-time donation is: Ko-fiで新しい一回限りの寄付を受け取ったときに発生します。
ja.Triggers when a new subscription is rece: Ko-fiで新しいサブスクリプションを受信したときにトリガーします。
ja.Triggers when a new commission is receiv: Ko-fiで新しい手数料を受け取ったときに発生します。
ja.Triggers when a new shop order is receiv: Ko-Fiで新しいショップの注文が受信されたときに発生します。
ja.To receive donation events, set up a web: 寄付イベントを受け取るには、Ko-fi ダッシュボードで Webhook を設定します。設定 > API/Webhooks に移動します。 URL {{webhookUrl}}を貼り付け、「寄付」イベントタイプを選択します。
ja.To receive subscription events, set up a: サブスクリプションイベントを受信するには、Ko-fi ダッシュボードで Webhook を設定します。設定 > API/Webhooks に移動します。 URL {{webhookUrl}}を貼り付け、"Subscription" イベントタイプを選択します。
ja.To receive commission events, set up a w: コミッションイベントを受け取るには、Ko-fi ダッシュボードで Webhook を設定します。設定 > API/Webhooks に移動します。 URL {{webhookUrl}}を貼り付け、"Commission" イベントタイプを選択します。
ja.To receive shop order events, set up a w: ショップ注文イベントを受信するには、Ko-FiダッシュボードでWebフックを設定してください: 設定 > API/Webhookを開きます。 URL {{webhookUrl}}を貼り付け、「ショップ注文」イベントタイプを選択します。
